text: I can't promise reimbursement without reviewing your situation, since it depends on the specifics of the transfer and Albert's current terms. If a Smart Transfer caused an overdraft, contact Albert's support team through the in-app chat right away with the date, the transfer amount, and any fee your bank charged, and they can review it and tell you what they can cover. In the meantime, you can lower your savings amount or pause Smart Transfers in the app so it doesn't happen again.
